messages:
maria.g: heads-up: int4-beta onboard (v2026-03) is at 5% AB for docs-long slice. Observed a coherence dip only on >5k token queries (MRR down ~3.4%). Raising for discussion: canary/autofallback thresholds?

devon: saw that in the smoke dashboard. any idea if it's KV cache related or quantization noise?

sandeep: ran quick compare: short-context perf is fine. Long-context token attention pattern shows higher entropy; suspect kv cache mismatch after chunking. attaching minimal stats.

sandeep: metrics: longdoc_mrr: baseline 0.921 -> int4 0.890 (delta -0.031). sample n=1200. p-value < 0.01 via bootstrap.

kelsey: thanks. propose temp gate: auto-fallback if delta_mrr <= -0.02 AND n>=1000 AND rolling p<0.05 over 30m. Also require manual ack if rollback hits >10% traffic.

maria.g: That seems reasonable. We should also ensure we use stratified samples across docs with code blocks/structured output since those regress more.

devon: One more thought: increase prefix_cache window to 8k tokens for int4 path to see if kv artifacts reduce. Small config to test:

devon: ```yaml
auto_fallback:
  enabled: true
  delta_threshold: 0.02
  min_samples: 1000
  rolling_window: 1800  # seconds
kv:
  prefix_window_tokens: 8192
```

canary-bot: :warning: canary-alert: int4-beta @5% traffic triggered delta_mrr -0.031 over 30m (n=1200). Action: queued snapshot and shadow replay.

maria.g: I'll spin a replay with prefix_window = 8192 + int4 quant decode fix. @sandeep can you start a qualified shadow run with 10k synthetic long-docs? aim for 3k effective samples.

sandeep: on it. ETA ~2h. Will log results to /evals/int4-longdoc/replay-1758889999

kelsey: for rollout docs, let's add hysteresis: require 3 consecutive 30m windows passing (delta <= 0.01) before promote beyond 10% traffic. Also add 'quiet-burn' at 25% for 24h.

devon: :thumbsup: also add a metric for 'structured-fidelity' since regenerations with code fences dropped lines in one example.

maria.g: Agree. After replay we decide: if smoke reduces delta <0.015 we can proceed with canary decay plan; else auto-fallback to baseline and open postmortem.

sandeep: replay started. will ping when results are in.

kelsey: added gating snippet to rollout playbook (link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollouts#int4).

maria.g: Thanks team. Keeping this thread for audit. Quick note: if autofallback triggers, canary-bot should annotate commit and open a troubleshooting ticket automatically.

canary-bot: :white_check_mark: noted. Will create ticket if auto-fallback executes.
